title: `UniV3TokenizedLp` can be attacked by an initial donation
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  When `UniV3TokenizedLp` has no user deposit, the first user can mint `1` wei LP, and then transfer `1e18` WETH to the `UniV3TokenizedLp` contract. This results in `totalSupply` being 1 while the value of the assets in the pool is very high.  Then, after the new user transfers the asset, it may mint 0 LP due to division loss.
